goalCredit: No duplicate credit from overlapping local runs. Source-bound CI remains pending.

independentReview.scope: Compared public project/source/row validation against actual API serializers and limits, Unicode, name trimming, immutable retry target IDs, source receipt membership, internal drafts and create replay semantics.

limits: Synthetic DOM state tests are not browser execution.
Upload byte-count agreement checks receipt consistency, not downloaded source byte proof.
Creation retains server-assigned identity and existing idempotent replay semantics.
preliminaryHarnessCorrection: A preliminary upload test preserved a shared source-object reference unlike JSON response parsing. Its source and project member objects were separated before the final same-test comparison. No production change was needed for that harness defect.
